claim.claim-text: 2. The imaging device of claim 1, further comprising a first wiring layer stacked on the first substrate, and a second wiring layer stacked on the second substrate, wherein the first wiring layer and the second wiring layer arranged to face one another.
3. The imaging device of any of the preceding claims, wherein the first substrate and the second substrate are electrically connected through the first wiring layer and the second wiring layer.

4. The imaging device of any of the preceding claims, wherein the photoelectric conversion section includes a photodiode, a transfer transistor, a floating diffusion, a switch transistor, a floating diffusion reset transistor, an intra-pixel amplification transistor, the imaging device further including a memory section in the second substrate, the memory section including a first switch transistor, the first capacitor, a first amplification transistor, a first selection transistor, a second switch transistor, the second capacitor, a second amplification transistor, and a second selection transistor.
5. The imaging device of any of the preceding claims, wherein the differential circuit is included in a third substrate.
6. The imaging device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the initialization section includes a capacitor and a switch.
7. The imaging device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein
the first capacitor holds a reset level, and the second capacitor holds a signal level.
8. The imaging device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein a ramp signal is input to the one end or the another end.
9. The imaging device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the differential circuit is a differential comparator.
10. The imaging device according to any of claims 1 to 8, wherein the differential circuit includes a differential amplifier.

11. The imaging device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein a ramp signal is input to one of the one end and the another end, and a signal in which a polarity of the ramp signal is inverted is input to the other end.
12. The imaging device according to any of claims 1 to 10, wherein a ramp signal is input to one of the one end and the another end, and a signal of a constant voltage is input to the other end.
13. The imaging device according to any of claims 1 to 6 and 8 to 12, wherein

the first capacitor holds the first signal photoelectrically converted in a first exposure period, and the second capacitor holds the second signal photoelectrically converted in a second exposure period.
